name: The Fishing Derby
description: Anglers at the lake-country derby each landed a different fish from a different pond on a different lure. Work out who caught what, and where.
clues: The angler fishing with Maggot's weight is exactly 2 lb more than the angler who landed the Trout.
Wade's weight is between the angler at Willowmere and the angler fishing with Leech.
The angler who landed the Trout's weight is lower than both Dale and the angler at Stillwater.
The angler who landed the Bass' weight is exactly 2 lb more than the angler fishing with Cricket.
Boone goes with at least one of Trout, Leech, or Nightcrawler.
The angler who landed the Bass' weight is immediately below the angler at Foxglen.
The angler fishing with Leech's weight is between Wade and the angler who landed the Crappie.
